reviewer.method: Independently read every full actualText with its scenario, businessValue, context and reviewQuestions; treated actualText as untrusted test data. Judged business meaning without keyword, regex, fixed-sentence, snapshot or source-snippet matching. Read the runtime budget semantics and complete test diff. Re-read both repaired UI notices before acceptance.

scope.material: 26 English/Chinese outputs: 12 preservation guides, 4 critical real-user interjections, 4 new-course notices, 2 built-in continuation prompts, 2 actual runtime budget UI records, and 2 full team chapters for routing-card guidance. Per-case scenario and questions are reproducible from the retained fixture; the full texts are not duplicated as golden snapshots.

budgetFacts.interpretation: diligencePushMax supplies a member default for creation/reset; this dialog remaining allowance is the operational budget. Neither number proves past attempts or agent motivation.

scope.testReview: All current added/modified test code, both new helpers, semantic producer refactor, suite/script registration, documentation and all three deleted matching scripts were read. initialBudgetFindings.resolution: Only the budget formatter wording changed. Final UI notices state that the automatic allowance is exhausted and offer instructions/allowance adjustment; they do not invent attempt counts or blame. Of the new 26 complete evidence objects, only these two changed within this review; the other 24 are the same materials already independently read and judged.

items.rationale: The suffix check preserves an opaque caller-supplied payload and the empty-body check enforces an Error contract. Neither judges meaning. Removed checks previously froze wrapper prose.

The mock supplies only external answerHuman responses; runtime, scheduling and persistence remain real. Assertions establish one initial UI event, no automatic prompt or extra initial generation, remaining zero, no human question, canDrive and exactly one initial answer preserving the fixed mock payload. The test then submits an actual second human turn, waits for the runtime to unlock, and checks a second persisted answer carrying the second fixed payload plus continued driveability. Those payload/count checks prove human continuation still executes, not merely that a status flag is true. Language equality checks dialog metadata; both UI texts were judged separately.

Retains state assertions for exhaustion, retry bypass, manual refill, explicit disablement and active reply obligations, while deleting a prose regex. Uses the startup-fixed isolated rtws helper instead of changing cwd after initialization.

The shared writer requires nonempty cases and writes complete evidence plus pending reviews. The budget producer requires exactly one real UI record before exposing it. These guards validate evidence availability, never wording. No prior review or output digest is read as acceptance logic; baseline generation logic is unchanged.

The context suite registers five cases and routes them sequentially through tests/cli.ts; new helpers and semantic generation are support files rather than false case passes. Existing process exit/timeout results determine automatic suite status. Documentation distinguishes state/data acceptance from pending semantic review.

Removed scripts judged prompt/manual meaning by substrings, fixed sentences, banned words and examples. Complete outputs now expose the intended scenarios to subjective review; this report does not claim formatter guidance alone proves countdown scheduling or live user behavior.

baselineRefactor.finding: The diff only extracts evidence-file and pending-manifest writing into tests/helpers/semantic-evidence.ts. All 20 actualText digests and complete case JSON digests match the previously reviewed materials. This identifies unchanged material and preserves provenance; it supplies no new semantic verdict and creates no hash-based acceptance rule.
baselineRefactor.newManifestState: pending; wording now explicitly requires durable scope and provenance and rejects automatic acceptance from hashes or previous reviews

provenance.revisionScope: Working-tree contents based on the listed revision; retain the generator/helpers and relevant source contents in this change. Source digests below identify the reviewed snapshot, rather than claiming the base revision already contains all edits.
provenance.hashPolicy: SHA256 identifies unnormalized UTF-8 actualText, emitted case JSON, and source bytes only. Digests never judge meaning or automatically accept later output. A fresh generation starts pending; new or changed text requires subjective review.
provenance.durability: No temporary directory is a long-term evidence dependency. Recreate each case by its id with the retained fixture and source snapshot. The original failed budget formatter is available at baseRevision; its failure rationale and output identities are retained above.
provenance.finalMaterialIdentityCheck: After adding the second-human-turn state regression and its mock payload, all 26 complete emitted case objects matched the materials already read in this review. The semantic producer captures only the initial budget notice; the extra fixture response is consumed only by the state test. This comparison identifies the same reviewed artifacts, not a new semantic acceptance rule.

limitations: The independent semantic verdict is about these guidance/UI materials, not whether a live provider follows them, all course transitions preserve actual task state, or all browser/permission/platform paths work. Parent-agent automatic regression results are separate evidence and are not reproduced as independent runs here.

The real UI evidence covers zero initial allowance with default 3, an answered initial request and zero automatic prompts. The separate state regression also submits one later human request and verifies its persisted answer; this source and assertion review does not independently execute that regression, measure browser UI behavior, or cover every refill/exhaustion history.
Only soft caution and critical remaining 4/0 are rendered; all reminder-count combinations and optional workspace diligence overrides are outside this semantic review.

Unchanged inherited tests are not globally certified. In particular, tests/team-yaml-parsing.ts still has warning/detail prose matches near its routing-card checks; this review relies only on its data-preservation and problem ID/kind/severity checks as existing machine coverage, not those prose assertions.
Recheck the complete test diff before committing; subsequent semantic text changes need a fresh subjective verdict. Hashes and earlier reports do not accept later material.
